name: Oposse
author: telep
description: Meta Muse, ChatGPT Dots and your Grok Bot roster behind one bar icon. Every AI assistant waiting on you shows its avatar beside it; pick one and its chat drops down from the bar.

barWidget.description: One icon for every assistant. Those waiting on you show beside it as their own avatars; click for the list, click a row to drop that chat down.

schema.label: Your dot's name (empty = found automatically)
schema.description: Learned from the browser (page titles, notifications). Set it here if it guesses wrong.

schema.label: Muse persona's name (empty = found automatically)
schema.description: Learned from the Muse window title. Set it here if it guesses wrong.

schema.label: Dots avatar's eyes (override)
schema.description: Found automatically in the picture. Only if it guesses wrong: lx,ly,rx,ry,width,height as fractions of the picture. none = no live eyes.

schema.label: Muse avatar's eyes (override)
schema.description: Found automatically in the picture. Only if it guesses wrong: lx,ly,rx,ry,width,height as fractions of the picture. none = no live eyes.

schema.label: What sits beside the icon
schema.description: avatars = a short ranked row of faces (see barMax); count = how many are waiting on you; none = the icon alone.

schema.label: Panel order
schema.description: attention = waiting on you first; channels = Assistants, then your Grok Bot sections; flat = by last message.

schema.label: Faces beside the icon (max)
schema.description: Ranked: waiting on your reply, then unread by recency, then the pinned assistant.

schema.label: Show who needs you
schema.description: On: beside the icon, up to barMax faces: whoever waits on your reply, then unread by recency, then the pinned one. Off: always just the pinned one. Also the 'bar:' toggle in the panel header.

schema.label: Pinned assistant
schema.description: Set with the pin button on a row in the panel. Empty = the first web assistant (Muse or Dots).

schema.label: Set up on every shell start
schema.description: Install Grok Bot if missing, start it, warm up Muse and Dots hidden, and open only what still needs a sign-in.
